# New

### General
* Library Mode now allows sorting. Additionally, you can now sort by Tags in both Library and Inventory modes.
* Added "Inventory" as an option in tag organization rules.
* Added a Pass All and Lot All button to the pop-out treasure pool UI.

### Vendors
Added a new tool that works the same as the Curio tool, allowing automatic restocking of common supplies like Frontier Soda, Trump Card Case, Angon, etc. from their respective vendors.
